value.data: Prestige Bellandur metro station (Blue Line) is under construction and slated to be operational by December 2026. The nearest operational metro stations on the Yellow Line include Hongasandra (5.75 km), Bommanahalli (5.93 km), and Kudlu Gate (6.05 km).

Bellandur experiences severe traffic congestion, especially during peak hours, particularly on the Outer Ring Road (ORR) and near tech parks. Commutes can be lengthy, with travel from Bellandur to Kempegowda International Airport taking up to 1 hour 45 minutes.

The Prestige Bellandur Metro Station on the Blue Line is under construction and expected to be operational by December 2026. Prestige Group is constructing a 1.5-km flyover connecting its upcoming Beta Tech Park in Bellandur directly to the Outer Ring Road (ORR), anticipated to be completed by mid-2027. This project also includes the widening of Kariyammana Agrahara Road. Additionally, there are plans for a 1 km long and 24-meter-wide road within the Bellandur Lake buffer zone and preparatory work for a 1.4 km buffer road as an alternative to Wind Tunnel Road.

Bellandur is a vibrant, tech-centric residential locality with well-developed social and physical infrastructure, offering a blend of residential and commercial spaces. It provides convenient access to major IT hubs, quality schools, hospitals, and a wide range of amenities. However, residents frequently contend with significant traffic congestion and waterlogging issues.
Urban, cosmopolitan, and vibrant, attracting IT professionals and young families with its array of hip cafes, craft beer breweries, international restaurants, and a lively social scene.

Bellandur faces a high risk of waterlogging, which is a recurring issue during heavy rains. This is attributed to narrowed and concretized drains, encroachment of wetlands, and incomplete drain development work. Notable incidents include severe flooding in September 2022 and May 2025, where parts of the Outer Ring Road and residential areas were inundated.
